BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-AFPredictionToolbars
BundleInfo.Author: Matthias Vorlaender
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Toolbar buttons for AF2/AF3 inspection and AlphaMissense mapping
BundleInfo.Description: Adds an AF toolbar tab with buttons for inspecting AF2 top-hit/all-hit outputs, AF3 top-hit/all-hit prediction folders, and AlphaMissense mapping onto one selected protein chain. The bundle contains the workflow logic directly in Python and does not depend on external .cxc scripts.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: AF Prediction Launcher :: General :: Inspect AF2 and AF3 prediction outputs and map AlphaMissense scores

Provider.name: af3-all
Provider.description: Choose an AF3 prediction folder and open all detected model/data pairs

Provider.name: af3-top
Provider.description: Choose an AF3 prediction folder and open the best detected model/data pair

Provider.name: af2-all
Provider.description: Choose an AF2 prediction folder and open all detected ranked hits

Provider.name: af2-top
Provider.description: Choose an AF2 prediction folder and open the best detected ranked hit

Provider.name: missense-map
Provider.description: Map AlphaMissense scores from a human UniProt entry onto one selected chain
